title: Match dependencies to bounded version advisories
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a synthetic local advisory database. dependencies contains {"name":string,"version":string}; advisories contains {"id":string,"name":string,"introduced":version,"fixed":version_or_null}. Versions must be exactly three nonnegative decimal integer components separated by dots; leading zeros are disallowed except the component "0". Compare component tuples numerically. A dependency is vulnerable when names match case-sensitively and introduced <= version < fixed; null fixed means no upper bound. Return {"findings":[{"name":...,"version":original_string,"advisories":[sorted unique IDs]},...]} only for vulnerable dependencies, preserving dependency order and duplicate dependency entries. Validate every version, even for unrelated packages; malformed versions or fixed<=introduced return {"error":"invalid_version"}. This task deliberately excludes prereleases, build metadata and package registry access. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 0, relative tolerance 0; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
